items: [fix] A new Fab product got no console in the session where you answered "Fab product". The console of a Fab product started only at the NEXT session start, and the agent, finding no `Claude/hooks`, offered the kit-template console (another project's data). Now `kit_install.py --kind <root> fab` starts the console of the product (its own lab, port 8766 or the next free one), prints its address, and says plainly that the template console is not the one to use; when it cannot start, it prints the exact command to run.
release.title: v1.123.1 — Answering Fab product starts its console
